exemplars.title: CreativeConnect: Supporting Reference Recombination for Graphic Design Ideation with Generative AI
exemplars.why: This is a near-definitional exemplar: every system-generated recombination is uniformly limited to a line sketch and one-line description, explicitly leaving users to supply specificity through reinterpretation.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: Unlike Inkspire, CreativeConnect’s evidence establishes the uniform ceiling, identifies both sparse output forms, and explicitly connects withheld detail to user reinterpretation.

exemplars.title: Inkspire: Supporting Design Exploration with Generative AI through Analogical Sketching
exemplars.why: Converting AI designs into lower-fidelity sketch scaffolding matches the central move of withholding finish so users can continue elaborating, although the evidence does not establish that this ceiling is uniform or unavoidable.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: Inkspire at least transforms generated artifacts into incomplete sketch scaffolds, whereas Quologue removes contextual anchors to stimulate reflection rather than producing low-detail artifacts for users to finish.

exemplars.title: Dust Off Kindle Highlights With Quologue: Surfacing Personal Data With Generative AI for Reflective Experiences
exemplars.why: This is only a weak boundary case: it deliberately withholds titles, authors, and full quotations so users supply personal meaning, but the mechanism is decontextualization rather than low-fidelity rendering of an artifact awaiting completion.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: There is no lower-ranked supplied candidate; Quologue occupies the third slot only because the candidate pool is exhausted and should not be treated as a strong positive exemplar.

notes: I preserved the consensus order but materially reduced Quologue from 1.95 to 1.3 because its evidence does not satisfy the structural signature: it removes contextual metadata rather than imposing a rendering-stage fidelity ceiling. It is best treated as a negative boundary case, so the supplied pool supports only two defensible positive exemplars. Inkspire is also weakly evidenced: its short feature description does not prove a uniform ceiling, lack of a higher-fidelity option, or explicit user completion. CreativeConnect is the only selection whose quote directly establishes the complete mechanism; even there, the evidence states design intent rather than measured impact.
pattern_name: Low Detail Outlines with User-Filled Specificity
